The hedge fund held 21,495 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.12M, down from 41,165 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kepos Capital Lp who had been investing in Walmart Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $254.30B market cap company. (NYSE:WMT) has risen 23.53% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 11.98% the S&P500.
